summary: AT&T Inc. filed an 8-K on April 30, 2026, under Item 8.01 (Other Events) and 9.01 (Financial Statements and Exhibits). The filing lists numerous outstanding debt securities and appears to be a routine update regarding the company's debt maturities and listed notes. No special situation event—such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, activist campaign, or restructuring—is disclosed. The registrant is solely the filer, and no substantive corporate action triggering a special-situation classification is present. This filing is a standard current report with no special-situation implications.
